functions.name: GetFocusRecipient
functions.docs: If the event replied with a constant explicit boundary rule this returns the desired focus recipient. Otherwise returns an invalid pointer.

functions.name: GetFocusDelegate
functions.docs: If the event replied with a delegate explicit boundary rule this returns the delegate to get the focus recipient. Delegate will be unbound if a constant widget was provided.

functions.name: Explicit
functions.docs: An event should return a FNavigationReply::Explicit() to let the system know to navigate to an explicit widget at the bounds of this widget.

functions.name: Custom
functions.docs: An event should return a FNavigationReply::Custom() to let the system know to call a custom delegate to get the widget to navigate to.

functions.name: CustomBoundary
functions.docs: An event should return a FNavigationReply::CustomBoundary() to let the system know to call a custom delegate to get the widget to navigate to is the widgets boundary is hit.

functions.name: Wrap
functions.docs: An event should return a FNavigationReply::Wrap() to let the system know to wrap at the bounds of this widget.

functions.name: Stop
functions.docs: An event should return a FNavigationReply::Stop() to let the system know to stop at the bounds of this widget.

functions.name: Escape
functions.docs: An event should return a FNavigationReply::Escape() to let the system know that a navigation can escape the bounds of this widget.
